AWS_REGION.description: AWS region for the S3 bucket, e.g. us-east-1

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: IAM access key scoped to the S3 bucket

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: IAM secret key scoped to the S3 bucket

AWS_S3_BUCKET.description: S3 bucket name for storing uploaded PDFs and generated Excel BOMs

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional: enables AI enrichment of ambiguous line items (free tier at aistudio.google.com/apikey)
